fields.Name: T227 - Grid More Actions Menu
fields.Description: Opens a grid's 'More actions' (overflow) menu and verifies it lists additional actions.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Products' entity grid — type 'Products' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click it (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Products). In the grid toolbar (upper-right), click the 'More actions' control — the vertical ellipsis (three-dots) icon. Verify an overflow menu opens listing additional grid/row actions, with no error. (Seeing the menu open with action items is success; you do NOT need to run an action.) Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The grid's 'More actions' (vertical ellipsis) control was clicked
An overflow menu opened listing additional actions
No error messages or crash pages
